An anchor-wrapped table inside a layout cell keeps its inner links clickable

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"br_in_tables\":true,\"compact_tables\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td><a href=\"/outer\"><table><tr><td><a href=\"/one\">One</a><a href=\"/two\">Two</a></td></tr></table></a></td></tr><tr><td>After</td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
